title: On Insisting on paying his own share
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：insist　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 insist 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the guide ① insisted on paying his own share without a word of thanks, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the guide ② insists on paying his own share at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ insist on paying his own share at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ insisted on paying his own share before — a line in the guidebook for July 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Insisting on paying his own share without a word of thanks, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ insist that the record was wrong at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Insist that the record was wrong at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a new traveller from the next valley ⑧ insists that the record was wrong without a word of thanks every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ledge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ insisted on paying his own share again when nobody else would.

⑩ To insist on paying his own share, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody insists on paying his own share at once again and somebody must insist on paying his own share without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 坚持（一般过去式 insisted on paying his own share：1990 年向导头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 坚持（一般现在 insists on paying his own share：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 坚持（不定式 to insist on paying his own share：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 坚持（过去完成时 had insisted on paying his own share：1984 年七月的旅行手册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 坚持（动名词 insisting on paying his own share 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 一口咬定（insist that the record was wrong：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去一口咬定一口咬定那条记载有误）
G. v. 一口咬定（insist that the record was wrong：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 坚持（后段两处：新来的旅人照例 insists that the record was wrong，而母亲又一次 insisted on paying his own share）

answers.why: insist 意为“坚持”，1990 年向导不图一句谢坚持坚持自己付他那一份，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 insisted。
insist 意为“坚持”，自那以后向导二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 insists。
insist 意为“坚持”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯坚持坚持自己付他那一份”，此处为不定式 to insist on paying his own share。
insist 意为“坚持”，旅行手册里 七月 那行字说明早在 1997 年之前就有人坚持过，故用过去完成时 had insisted。
insist 意为“坚持”，向导说“坚持坚持自己付他那一份这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 insisting on paying his own share 作主语。
insist 意为“一口咬定”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去一口咬定一口咬定那条记载有误”，should ever 之后用原形 insist that the record was wrong。
insist 意为“一口咬定”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻一口咬定一口咬定那条记载有误（insist that the record was wrong at once），以后再也不要提起。
insist 意为“坚持”，新来的旅人每个日子都照例一口咬定一口咬定那条记载有误，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 insists。
insist 意为“坚持”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢坚持坚持自己付他那一份，用一般过去式 insisted 叙述。
insist 意为“坚持”，结尾那句是母亲 2002 年的话：要坚持坚持自己付他那一份，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 insist 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the guide insisted on paying his own share without a word of thanks, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the guide insists on paying his own share at once whenever the valley asks.
Insisting on paying his own share without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever insist that the record was wrong at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next valley insists that the record was wrong without a word of thanks every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother insisted on paying his own share again, and the valley remembered that half.
